svg.title: CharityMS app icon
svg.desc: Heart motif — the charity / non-profit preset emblem (#306 starter placeholder). White emblem on a rounded indigo tile. HOW TO RECOLOUR: every colour is a named token in (brand, on-brand) referenced by url(#token). Edit a token's stop-color(s) once to recolour everywhere it is used.

linearGradient.desc: BRAND token — primary indigo gradient. Edit these two stop-colors to recolour the brand everywhere it is referenced via fill="url(#brand)".
ON-BRAND token — emblem colour on the indigo tile. Edit the stop-colors to recolour everything referencing url(#on-brand).

g.title: Heart
g.desc: A single rounded heart shape — the charity / giving cue.
